title: First-of-Season and Rare Bird Alert
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdnet:detection confidence>0.85
| stats earliest(_time) as first_heard, count as detections by species
| eval brand_new=if(first_heard>relative_time(now(),"-2d"),1,0), rare=if(detections<=2,1,0)
| where brand_new=1 OR rare=1
| sort - first_heard
description: Flags the first appearance of a migratory species and the rarely heard visitors, the highlights every garden birder waits for.
value: First-of-season and rare detections are the exciting moments; surfacing them automatically means you never miss a notable visitor.
implementation: Ingest high-confidence BirdNET detections; alert on newly heard or seldom-heard species.
visualization: Table of new-of-season and rare species with first-heard time.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you when a new migrating bird arrives for the season or a rare one visits, the highlights for bird lovers.
